subject: Historical average global economic growth
evidence_text: The global economy in 2025 is likely to grow not only below its historical average (2000-19) of 3.7 per cent, but also below the growth of 3.3 per cent in 2024, on account of heightened global trade protectionism, rising policy uncertainty and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
